GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH w AS (SELECT f.*, o.status, o.order_ts_utc FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.store_key=46 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-08-25' AND '2025-12-21')
SELECT coalesce(status,'NO ORDER') status, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) orders,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_date_differs,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hki_date_differs,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ord_date_differs,
 sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_off,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negs
FROM w GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

x AS (SELECT d, coalesce(s.gross_sales,0) sales, coalesce(r.ret,0) ret FROM s FULL JOIN r USING(d))

FROM x JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date=x.d GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
